title: The Mug of Mint Water
youtube_title: The Mug of Mint Water | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Ilaria sees that a mug of mint water on the step will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Ilaria makes a smaller, even share so Opal is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
